title: DECA shared fault book (Pi ↔ GNS3)
mentor_sentence: We removed TRex and run the same iperf3 + NetEM + BGP/CPU/util fault book on Pi and GNS3, with aligned SLAs, so the live Pi lab and the GNS3 tool they use share one SD-WAN policy and one predictive feature space.

traffic.htb_notes: PE root 40mbit; Payload RED on 1:15; dport 5004→1:10 / 5006→1:15; NetEM on underlay (Pi gre-te-core · GNS3 CORE-N eth0 / GRE) — never wipe PE HTB

notes: Canonical shapes = Pi scripts. GNS3 inject defaults match Pi; demo.* may shorten for NOC jury.
Do not mash unlabeled Pi + GNS3 CSVs until L1–L5 Prom series share protocol shapes.
GNS3 injects must hit real NetEM + iperf + stress-ng; chaos_state.json is overlay/fallback only.
Train Q1 primarily on Pi (honest dynamics); add GNS3 after matched texture; Q2 may use a fabric feature.
